responses.text: {Primm, new Sheriff}Primm's got some new sheriff watching over the town now.
{Primm, NCR rule}The NCR's all over Primm. Steer clear.
{Kimball dead}Somebody whacked the NCR president. Got what was coming to him.
{Caesar dead}Someone took out the Legion's boss. Doubt it'll stop them for long, though.
{Middle Game}Lot more troops on the road these days. Wonder what's up.
{Late Game}Best to lay low. The NCR and the Legion are about to have it out.
{Liked 1}You and me are all right.
{Liked 2}Good to know that you've got my back.
{Liked 3}Don't let the NCR catch up to you, all right?
{Rascal 1}You seem to be on the level.
{Rascal 2}Heard some things about you. {clarifying}Good things.
{Rascal 3}Guess we're on the same side.
{Wild Child 1}I respect you, but I want nothing to do with you.
{Wild Child 2}I've heard some crazy stories about you.
{Wild Child 3}Whatever is you want, keep me out of it. I've heard the stories.
{Mixed 1}I don't think I'll be turning my back to you anytime soon.
{Mixed 2}Keep your hands where I can see them - makes me feel better.
{Mixed 3}You make it hard to trust you, you know that?
{Hated 1}You better be sleeping with one eye open.
{Hated 2}Why are you even talking to me?
{Hated 3}I'd kill you right now if I could.
{Thug 1}You're not exactly making friends around here, are you?
{Thug 2}You and I have got nothing to talk about.
{Thug 3}Just keep on walking.
{Companion Reaction - Lily}Holy fuck. Never seen a mutant like that before.
{Companion Reaction - Rex}Didn't know they still had robo-dogs around.
{Companion Reaction - Raul}Wouldn't want to live forever if I had to look like a ghoul.
{Companion Reaction - Boone} {slight awe, respectful}That guy's got cold eyes. Definitely ex-military.
{Companion Reaction - Veronica}Now there's a fine-looking woman. Just needs to ditch the robe.
{Companion Reaction - Cass}Tough-looking woman. Something tells me she aims for the crotch.
{Companion Reaction - Arcade}We bought and sold guys like Four-Eyes over there like property back in the prison.
{slight threat}You eyeballing me?
Damn. Running low on smokes again.
Any lawman that comes after me won't have it easy.
Never gets old when something blows up.
No way I'm going back to prison.
{Companion Reaction - EDE}Wouldn't mind having one of those little flying robots myself.
Back off. This is our turf.
Not gonna stay nice if you don't leave.
Clear out. You're not welcome here.
